preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some Gator tokens to initiate transfer

exploit_hint: The vulnerability is that tokens sent to the burn address (0x000...dEaD) are not actually burned (total supply not reduced). Instead, they're transferred to the dead address where they remain in circulation. To demonstrate, simply transfer tokens to the BURN_ADDRESS (0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD) using the transfer() function. The total supply will remain unchanged, proving tokens aren't burned. No financial gain is possible, but the logic flaw can be verified.
